name: Disconnector-closed breaker interlock
summary: Requires the selected disconnector to occupy its defined closed position before breaker closing.
description: Requires the selected disconnector to occupy its defined closed position before breaker closing. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Disconnector closed proof” at the input and “Breaker close permission” at the output. A permissive is valid only for its assigned path.
